fields.name: CRM Lead-custom_blockwise_prospect_source_uuid
fields.label: Blockwise prospect source UUID
fields.description: Read-only UUID linking this CRM Lead to its Blockwise prospect source.

fields.name: CRM Lead-custom_blockwise_evidence_refs
fields.label: Blockwise evidence references
fields.description: Read-only references to approved evidence records. Do not store contact notes or credentials.

fields.name: CRM Lead-custom_blockwise_eligibility
fields.label: Blockwise eligibility
fields.description: Explicit owner review state. A Lead is never auto-marked eligible.

fields.name: Contact-custom_blockwise_trial_state
fields.label: Blockwise trial state
fields.description: Read-only native Blockwise trial state mirror. Not an access decision.

fields.name: Contact-custom_blockwise_trial_started_at
fields.label: Blockwise trial started at
fields.description: Read-only native Blockwise trial start fact mirror.

fields.name: Contact-custom_blockwise_trial_ends_at
fields.label: Blockwise trial ends at
fields.description: Read-only native Blockwise trial end fact mirror.

fields.name: Contact-custom_blockwise_source_observed_at
fields.label: Blockwise source observed at
fields.description: Read-only time the source snapshot was observed. Never the sync time.

fields.name: Contact-custom_blockwise_sync_state
fields.label: Blockwise sync state
fields.description: Read-only connector-owned mirror state. Never set by an operator.

fields.name: Contact-custom_blockwise_subscription_status
fields.label: Blockwise subscription status
fields.description: Read-only subscription status mirror. Stripe remains authoritative for billing.

fields.name: Contact-custom_blockwise_access_status
fields.label: Blockwise access status
fields.description: Read-only access status mirror. Blockwise remains authoritative for access.

fields.name: Contact-custom_blockwise_last_synced_at
fields.label: Blockwise last synced at
fields.description: Read-only timestamp for the last accepted Blockwise mirror update.
